### F1 — FIXED

The code: `arr/kerbExact.ts` `exactPixelEntry` (:203 – 232) now takes each axis's pixel as the rounding rule gives it —
`loIn = C > 0`, `hiIn = C < 0`: [C − ½, C + ½) for a positive centre, (C − ½, C + ½] for a negative one, (−½, ½) at 0 —
so the pixels partition the plane exactly as `roundHalfAway` does and a rounded crossing's pixel holds the exact
crossing in every quadrant; after the snap-rounding pass and its repeats (still at most four) a crossing left on a hot
pixel, or any crossing left after them, is a `check` failure (:548 – 558), never a traced region; the header (:46 – 62)
states it. Re-derived by hand: the c > 0 and c < 0 intervals are the pre-images of half-away rounding (c + ½ rounds to
c + 1 for c > 0, c − ½ to c − 1 for c < 0, ±½ to ±1).
